Depends on the Secret Library Quest and on gathering the addon items

The {wiki:Battle Mage Outfits|Battle Mage Outfits} are given by {npc:Dedoras}, in Edron, to those who completed the first 6 missions of {wiki:The Secret Library Quest}. The addons cost 5 {item:Sturdy Book|Sturdy Books} (first) and 20 {item:Epaulette|Epaulettes} (second).
No minimum level stated, but the **recommended level is 300+**.
The first **6 missions** of {wiki:The Secret Library Quest} completed (for the base outfit).
You can collect {item:Sturdy Book|Sturdy Books} and {item:Epaulette|Epaulettes} while doing the Secret Library Quest, or buy them from other players.
Complete the **first 6 missions** of {wiki:The Secret Library Quest}.

{npc:Dedoras} is not in the city of Edron, but in the **southeast** of the island of {wiki:Cormaya}, south of Edron. At the boat in the **north** of Edron, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You land at the **north** port of Cormaya, next to {npc:Pemaret}; from there walk **southeast** to Dedoras.
You can also reach Cormaya by the {wiki:Steamship} from Kazordoon or Farmine.
In the southeast of **Cormaya**, talk to {npc:Dedoras} ({key:hi}) to receive the base outfit.

To leave Cormaya, go back to the **north** port of the island and talk to {npc:Pemaret}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You land at the port of {wiki:Edron}. For the addons, take the same route (Captain Seahorse → Cormaya) once you have the items.
Bring **5 {item:Sturdy Book|Sturdy Books}** to {npc:Dedoras} and hand them over.
Male Battle Mage with the first addon
Female Battle Mage with the first addon
Bring **20 {item:Epaulette|Epaulettes}** to {npc:Dedoras} and hand them over.
Male Battle Mage with the second addon
Female Battle Mage with the second addon
